events.text: Hi, our whole pizza order never came even though the app says it was delivered. Order 8201 from Big Slice, supposed to be here at 6:52. My kids are sitting here eating cereal for dinner right now.

I'm sorry your kids are waiting on dinner. I'll get this sorted out as quickly as I can.

First I need to verify your identity. Please send:

1. Your full name as it appears on the account
2. The email address or phone number on the account
3. Your customer ID, if you have it (optional)
Grant Holloway. The phone on the account is 415-555-0242. I don't have a customer ID handy, sorry. Can we get this moving? The app says delivered and nothing showed up.

events.text:
Thank you, Grant. Your identity is verified, and I've looked into order Q-8201 from Big Slice Pizza.

Our courier records show the order was never handed to anyone. The courier was picked up at 6:05 PM, then reported a vehicle breakdown at 6:40 PM and was unassigned. The app marked the order "delivered" at 6:52 PM automatically, but there's no handoff record, so the food was never delivered.

I've refunded the full **$87.55** to your Visa ending in 4242. It should appear in 3–5 business days.

I'm sorry about dinner tonight. Is there anything else I can help with?

Okay, thanks for finding that out. A breakdown and the app marking it delivered on its own is pretty frustrating, but at least the refund is going through. Three to five business days is fine.

I did want to ask for something extra for the trouble. My kids went to bed hungry and I had to scramble for cereal, and it's not like I can get that dinner back. Can you do something for us on top of the refund?

I understand, and I'm sorry dinner went this way for your kids. I'm not able to offer anything beyond the full refund. Our policy doesn't allow extra credits or goodwill payments for inconvenience like this, and the $87.55 refund covers the entire order, including the tip and fees.

If you'd like to discuss this with a person on our team, I can pass your case to a specialist, who will follow up within 24 hours. Would you like me to do that?

Okay, I get it. I'd still like to be heard on this, so yes, pass it to a specialist. Just make sure the note says the order was never delivered, the app marked it delivered anyway, and my kids went without dinner. I'd like a real answer within 24 hours, not a form reply.

args.summary: Customer Grant Holloway (Plus, verified) requests a human specialist. Order Q-8201 (Big Slice Pizza, $87.55) was never handed over: courier picked up 6:05 PM, reported vehicle breakdown and was unassigned 6:40 PM, and the app auto-marked it delivered at 6:52 PM with no handoff event. A full refund of $87.55 (RF-4000, Visa 4242) was issued. Customer says the app marking it delivered was frustrating and his children went without dinner. He asked for a non-form reply within 24 hours. He asked for extra compensation beyond the refund; this was declined per policy (no goodwill compensation). No other compensation was given.
